Setup.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Snapwell
Setup.Welcome.Lead: Throw a window to snap it to nearby cells. You can also use hotkeys or the launcher.
Setup.Welcome.ThrowHint: Grab the title bar and throw toward the target.
Setup.Standard.Title: Turn off Windows Snap?
Setup.Standard.Lead: Windows Snap can compete with Snapwell. While Snapwell is active, it can make these changes.
Setup.Standard.Consent: I understand that Snapwell saves the original values and restores them when turned off, on exit, or on restart after a crash.
Setup.Standard.Hint: You can keep Windows Snap on. Both Windows and Snapwell will then snap windows when you drag.
Setup.Hotkeys.Title: Check hotkeys
Setup.Hotkeys.Lead: Checked for conflicts with hotkeys on this PC.
Setup.Hotkeys.Hint: You can change conflicting keys later in Hotkeys settings.
Setup.Grid.Title: Choose a grid
Setup.Grid.Lead: A cell is the basic unit of placement. You can change the grid for each monitor later.
Setup.Error.Load: Can't read or write settings. Check the file location, permissions, and Snapwell version, then reopen setup.
Setup.Error.ReadOnly: These settings are read-only. Update Snapwell and reopen setup to save.
Setup.Error.Save: Couldn't save settings. Check the file location and permissions, then try again.
Setup.Welcome.LauncherTemplate: Open the launcher with {keys} or from the tray menu.
Setup.Welcome.KeysTemplate: Use {keys} + arrow keys for halves; add {shift} to grow or shrink by one cell.
